text:
sara_support: FYI — customer cust-387 reporting their embeddings index crashed after we applied their pinned model yesterday. They say vectors used to be 1536 but now are 1024.

cust-387: yep — after the pin our batch job failed with: "Dimension mismatch: index expects 1536 but received 1024". Quick log: "embedding[0] length=1024". We didn't change client code.

jen_cs: ugh. asked for repro and sample response. They pasted a tiny snippet and curl.

cust-387: sample curl: 
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_cust123\" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/embedding-v2","input":"hello world"}'
response: {"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.002,...],"length":1024}]}

sara_support: thanks — can you also confirm whether you were pinned to a variant? They said they pinned to the tenant-locked model yesterday.

cust-387: yes, we pinned to tenant:cust-387:embedding-v2@2026-03-15. No other changes.

mike_eng: jumping in. quick hypothesis: when the pin was created we accidentally mapped to the quantized /lite variant. That variant produces a 1024-dim embedding (model architecture change), not just quantization.

raj_engineer: confirming — I see a pinned-mapping change in the pin-service audit: tenant:cust-387 -> redwood/embedding-v2-lite@rev-42 at 2026-03-15T18:03Z. That variant was introduced for cost-savings and has 1024 dim.

mike_eng: this explains the index failure. Index expects 1536 (old embedding size). Two immediate remediation options:
- rollback the pin to the full 1536 variant (redwood/embedding-v2-full@rev-39)
- or ask the customer to reindex with 1024 vectors (if they accept the quality tradeoff)

raj_engineer: to repro locally:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='sk_test')
resp = c.embeddings.create(model='redwood/embedding-v2-lite', input='test')
print(len(resp.data[0].embedding))  # -> 1024
```

mike_eng: also adding a short-term compatibility shim we can deploy: a server-side padding adapter that will pad 1024->1536 with zeros when content-length header indicates an older index. It's hacky but could prevent customer downtime while we coordinate rollback/reindex. Needs approval from product/security.

deploy-bot: pinned-mapping-update: tenant:cust-387 pinned to redwood/embedding-v2-lite@rev-42 by ops_john at 2026-03-15T18:03:12Z

jen_cs: I'll coordinate with the customer — sounding like they don't want to reindex overnight. Would prefer we restore previous behavior.

mike_eng: next steps: I will open a rollback PR to pin-service to point tenant:cust-387 -> redwood/embedding-v2-full@rev-39. Raj, can you validate that the full variant still returns 1536?

raj_engineer: validated on staging: full variant returns 1536. will run quick canary.

jen_cs: I'll tell cust-387 the temporary mitigation (we can either rollback the pin now or we can enable a pad-shim if ops want zero-downtime). They prefer rollback.

sara_support: opening internal ticket TC-9876 and marking P1 because customer production indexing is blocked. tagging eng oncall.

mike_eng: noted. if rollback approved, ETA ~15-30m to update pin-service and wait for cache TTLs to expire.

cust-387: thanks — appreciate the quick follow-up. please keep us posted.

sara_support: looping in product/security for the pad-shim discussion but we'll proceed with rollback for immediate customer unblock. :thumbsup:

mike_eng: rollback done, canaries look good. raj please confirm after 5m.

raj_engineer: canaries green, full rollout in progress. customer should see 1536 vectors again.

jen_cs: messaging cust-387 now with repro steps and suggested postmortem (pin review).

cust-387: confirmed — indexing resumed and no more dimension errors. thanks all. :tada:

sara_support: closing loop here. follow-up: audit pin-creation flow to ensure variant selection requires explicit confirmation; add warning when pin maps to different embedding width. action items: TC-9876 -> eng + product.
